{{Quote|That girl's crazy! We're protecting her?!|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Bounty (episode)" />}}
'''Pluma Sodi''' was a member of the Kage Warriors and the sister of [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]], the leader of the tribe. She was captured by [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]], but was given back to her brother by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==History==
A young [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] girl at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Pluma Sodi was desired by the loathsome lord of her home planet [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]], [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]]. Blank wanted Sodi as his young bride, and had his soldiers capture her and imprison her in a chest against her will. To safely transport her to Blank's underground fortress via [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]], Blank hired a team of highly skilled bounty hunters, led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to protect her. Little did they know that the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] would ambush the tram in an attempt to rescue Sodi.<ref name="Bounty (episode)" />

After [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]], Sodi's brother, found her, he was caught by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and both were handcuffed to the subtram's seats. Sodi pleaded with Ventress, her entreaty about the unfairness of being ripped from her home seemingly striking a chord with Ventress. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] instead bound and gagged Boba and stuffed him in the box, leaving him for Blank after receiving her credits. Later, halfway back to the station, Ventress took Sodi and Krismo to the very back of the subtram, where Krismo signaled a [[Milodon/Legends|Milodon]]. When Ventress got her additional credits from the Kage, she released Sodi, who thanked her before the warriors departed.<ref name="Bounty (episode)" />

==Personality and traits==
Pluma was a kind girl who greatly disliked war and fighting. She was also very polite, for she thanked [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] after she was released.<ref name="Bounty (episode)" />
